name: more-than-human-skills
description: Agentic skills and commands for checking whether what we build serves all living things — not just humans. Four lenses: who is affected, what it costs ecologically, when the user is not human, and what we are trading away without writing it down.

plugins.name: more-than-human
plugins.description: Non-human stakeholder mapping, AI energy/water/hardware footprint estimation, animal-computer interaction, and a harm tradeoff ledger with named acceptors — plus /audit-more-than-human.
